name: The Curse of Ula’tek Reaches the Coiled Isle
summary: The Midnight campaign continues on the Coiled Isle as Zul’jarra pursues Zul’jan and champions confront the Ula’tek threat.
description: Blizzard states that Zul’jan’s actions unleashed Ula’tek and that the Venomous Abyss raid confronts her. This record does not infer later campaign outcomes.
